kind: transparent execution of downloaded static and dynamic ELF binaries (self-build exec shim)

mechanism.shim: runtime/harmonyos/native/mh-exec-shim.c compiled freestanding (-nostdlib, raw syscalls, no NEEDED libs) into libguest_mh_exec_shim.so, bound at /usr/lib/libmh-exec-shim.so
mechanism.activation: poc.c sets LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/libmh-exec-shim.so for the managed shell child only when MH_SELF_BUILD is defined
mechanism.behavior: execve() probes the target: ELF files whose file-backed PROT_EXEC mapping succeeds (signed bindings) pass through; unsigned ELFs are redirected to /usr/bin/python3 /usr/bin/mh-exec <path> <args>; scripts/non-ELF pass through; MH_EXEC_REDIRECT guards recursion
